reference: For he exhorts them not only to read, but search and thoroughly examine the scriptures: he would not have them content with a slight perusal, but requires an assiduous, keen, laborious diligence in examining and investigating their meaning, such as those apply who search with anxious toil for treasures buried in the earth.

english_concat: And when Christ commanded without exception that the sacred scriptures should be searched, not these only, or those, or some particular ones, it is manifest that by these words it is prescribed that we should search them all, not, by clinging to certain parts of the scriptures, despise or pass over the rest. For they all give plain testimony to Christ.
reference: Now since Christ hath bid us search the scriptures without exception, not this part, or that part, or the other, it is mani- fest that in these words we are commanded to search the whole of scripture; not to confine ourselves to certain portions of it, while we despise or overlook the rest. english_concat: That I may handle it perspicuously and by a certain method, I judge that the whole may be distributed into six questions in this manner. We are commanded to search the scriptures:
reference: troversy, which I shall now attempt to explain. In order to effect this clearly and methodically, I think it may be all divided into six questions, after the following manner.

latin_concat: diſtribui poſſe iudicamus. Iubemur Scripturas ſcru- tari: quod vt rectè fiat, primùm intelligendum eſt, quinam illi ſint Scripturarum libri genuini, in qui- bus ſcrutandis & verſandis nos occupatos eſſe opor- teat. Ergo hæc erit prima quæſtio, De numero Canoni- corum librorum Scripturæ.
english_concat: We are commanded to search the scriptures: and that this may rightly be done, it must first be understood which are the genuine books of the scriptures, in the searching and studying of which I ought to be occupied. Therefore this will be the first question, Of the number of the canonical books of scripture.
reference: We are commanded to search the scriptures : and for that purpose we must first understand, what are those genuine books of scripture, in searching and turning over which it behoves us to be occupied. The first question therefore shall be, Of the num- ber of the canonical books of scripture.

latin_concat: Iubemur Scripturas ſcrutari: in quo proximè vi- dendum eſt, quibus hoc præceptum fuerit, vtrum doctis tantùm & linguarum peritis,an piis omnibus. Ergo ſecunda queſtio erit,De Scripturarum verſionibus, ſacrisq́ vernaculis.
english_concat: We are commanded to search the scriptures: wherein next it must be seen, to whom this precept was given, whether to the learned only and those skilled in the languages, or to all the godly. Therefore the second question will be, Of the versions of the scriptures, and of sacred vernacular translations.
reference: We are commanded to search the scriptures: and therefore we must next consider, to whom this precept is addressed ; whether only to the learned, and those skilled in the ancient languages, or to all the faithful. The second question therefore shall be, Of versions of the scripture and sacred rites in the vulgar tongue.

latin_concat: Iubemur Scripturas ſcrutari: ex quo manifeſtum eſt, ſcripturas dignitate atque authoritate ſumma præditas eſſe, quando ad eas nos Chriſtus ipſe reuo- cat ac remittit. Ergo tertia quæſtio erit, De authorita- te Scripturæ, vtrùm hanc tantam fidem atque dignita- tem ex ſe habeat, ſuoque authore Spiritu ſancto, an ex Eccleſiæ teſtimonio.
english_concat: We are commanded to search the scriptures: from which it is manifest that the scriptures are endowed with the highest dignity and authority, since Christ himself recalls and sends us back to them. Therefore the third question will be, Of the authority of scripture, whether it has this great credit and dignity of itself, and from its author the Holy Spirit, or from the testimony of the church.
reference: We are commanded to search the scriptures : whence it appears that the scriptures enjoy a very high dignity and authority, since Christ himself appeals and refers us to them. The third question therefore shall be, Of the authority of scripture; whether it have this so great credibility and dignity of itself, and from the Holy Ghost its author, or from the testimony of the church.
